title: Local Monodromy of Constructible Sheaves
summary: Given a morphism $f: X \rightarrow S$ of complex algebraic varieties and a constructible sheaf $\mathcal{G}$ on $X$, we compute the local monodromy of $Rf_*(\mathcal{G})$ and $Rf_!(\mathcal{G})$ in terms of the local monodromy of $\mathcal{G}$. Our results generalize previous results by Brieskorn, Borel, Clemens, Deligne, Landsman, Griffiths, Grothendieck, and Kashiwara in the setting of quasi-unipotent sheaves.
